summary: Banco Bradesco filed a Form 6-K disclosing a capital increase via a rights offering, as resolved by the Board of Directors on July 29, 2026. The company will issue 302,876,396 common shares at R$15.43 and 301,976,357 preferred shares at R$17.64, totaling R$10 billion (approximately US$1.8 billion). Shareholders have preemptive rights from August 6 to September 4, 2026, based on holdings as of August 4, 2026, at a ratio of 5.72%. Unsubscribed shares may be allocated to interested subscribers, with a partial approval requiring a minimum of R$8 billion. Payments may be made in cash or credited against JCP dividends. Watch for subscription demand and allocation of unsubscribed shares.
